title: Angelia release event envelope, v1 (draft, pre-1.0)
description: Angelia's profile of a CloudEvents 1.0 event in JSON structured mode for the release event types dev.angelia.release.published.v1, dev.angelia.release.yanked.v1 and dev.angelia.release.prerelease.v1. The three types share one data schema (schemas/release/v1.json). DRAFT: while the spec repository is at version 0.x this profile may still change in a breaking way in any 0.x minor release; it is frozen at spec 1.0.0. v1 defines no extension attributes and producers emit none, but other producers or intermediaries (brokers, tracing) may add CloudEvents extension attributes: any attribute whose name is 1 to 20 lower-case letters or digits is allowed, and consumers must ignore attributes they do not know. Other unknown names are rejected.
$comment: DRAFT (spec 0.x). Profile: docs/proposals/0001-release-event-v1-fields.md section 2 (Accepted). Per-attribute docs: docs/release-event-v1.md.

^[a-z0-9]{1,20}$.$comment: CloudEvents extension attributes (CloudEvents 1.0 attribute naming: lower-case a-z and 0-9, at most 20 characters recommended). Allowed and ignored by consumers; v1 producers emit none.

type.description: Event type: reverse-DNS prefix dev.angelia., the short type, then .v<major>. The short type (for example release.published) is the type without the dev.angelia. prefix and the .v1 suffix; it is what subscription filters use.

source.description: The watch that produced the event: angelia://<instance>/watches/<watch_id>, where <instance> is the instance name from the instance configuration and <watch_id> equals data.watch.id.

id.description: Event id: a ULID (26 characters, Crockford base32, upper case) generated once when the event is written. Every delivery attempt, retry and replay of the event carries the same id; consumers deduplicate on it. source + id is globally unique.

subject.description: <source kind>:<package>@<version>, with the raw upstream version (data.source, data.package, data.version). Lets brokers and routers filter without parsing data.

time.description: When the event was emitted (the end of the check that emitted it): RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix, at most millisecond precision. With a cooldown this is later than data.detected_at.

dataschema.description: URI of the data schema: the $id of schemas/release/v1.json. An identifier, not promised to be fetchable.
